tool_input.command: rm scripts/_scratch_inspect.py; ls scripts/ | grep scratch

result:
Implementation complete. Summary:

- **`src/deckdoctor/recommendations.py`**: `build_review_packet()` and `build_compare_packet()`, both returning `reports.Report`. Review includes gameplan/pins/rejections/curve/lands, a compact per-card inventory (no full oracle text for all ~100 cards), bounded tagless direct-upgrade discovery (proves e.g. `Costly Bolt {2}{U}` → `Cheap Bolt {1}{U}` with zero shared tags, via a single `type_line`-scoped SQL scan + `classify_direct_upgrade`), and role-tagged broader suggestions filling the remaining `--limit` budget. Compare works for any two named cards, shows full text/cost/faces, typed mana cost, conditional-cost-keyword flags, direct-upgrade classification, optional role comparison, and `swaps.validate_swaps` results.
- **`src/deckdoctor/recommendation_cli.py`**: `main(argv)` routing `review`/`compare`, independent of `cli.py` (no circular import), every outcome (success or failure) in the common `Report`/`Finding` JSON envelope. Exit 0 success, 2 invalid input/blocked swap, 3 DB unavailable.
- **`tests/test_recommendations.py`**: 7 decisive tests, all against synthetic per-test sqlite DBs.

Red → green confirmed (`ImportError` → `7 passed`), no regressions in the related suite (109 passed) or full suite (405 passed, 24 deselected). `CLAUDE-HANDOFF.md` has exact commands/results and design rationale. One leftover: `scripts/_scratch_inspect.py` (outside my owned files) couldn't be `rm`'d in this sandbox — emptied to zero bytes, noted in the handoff for whoever has delete rights.
